format: Output presentation. JSON retains full identities, versions and response variants for automation.
generation: Exact capture policy generation returned by status; prevents applying controls to a replacement installation policy.
expected_revision: Observed capture policy revision. Refresh status after a stale-policy rejection.
source: Exact retained capture source identity selected for historical import.
request_id: Stable mutation request identity. Preserve this ID and identical intent across retries and status recovery.
limit: Maximum entries requested for this bounded page; server and provider limits still apply.
after: Exclusive identity after which to continue listing within the selected metadata state.
at_metadata: Exact Git companion metadata commit to pin for this page. It does not select a JJ code operation.
cursor: Opaque continuation returned by the preceding page. Retain the same query and selected repository.
thread_id: Exact Thread or review-thread identity in the selected repository; creation supplies the new identity.
title: Complete intended title, subject to the domain's validation and size limits.
baseline: Path to a typed JSON baseline document retained with the new Thread.
intent: Path to the complete typed JSON intent. Retain the same bytes and request identity when retrying.
target: Path to a typed JSON reaction target naming the exact artifact and version.
value: Path to a typed JSON reaction value. On conflict resolution, omission clears the observed selection.
observed: Path to the JSON set of exact observed reaction object references. Clear and resolve act on that set.
emoji_id: Stable custom emoji identity; definitions and retirement retain its version history.
expected: Exact currently selected custom emoji definition object; guards replacement or retirement against stale state.
shortcode: Custom emoji shortcode to validate and retain in the repository library.
label: Human-readable custom emoji label, including its accessible name.
asset: Path to bounded raster image bytes for the custom emoji; the provider validates format and dimensions.
operation: Exact native JJ operation identity selecting the code evidence to inspect.
record: Path to the complete typed portable association or checkpoint JSON document.
expected_version: Exact currently selected entity version returned by its read command; prevents silently overwriting changed state.
agents: Integration names to enable in the device registry. Parser values include profiles whose execution may remain unsupported; inspect status.
agent: Integration to set up or remove. Only the selected jj-store-owned hook/plugin configuration is changed.
anchor: Path to the typed review-anchor JSON document. The selected provider must support and verify that anchor kind.
expected_workflow_version: Observed numeric review workflow version required by this reply.
parent_comment_id: Exact existing comment identity to reply to; omission creates a top-level comment.
comment_id: Exact review comment identity in the selected repository.
expected_revision_id: Exact visible comment revision observed before this edit or moderation command.
expected_revision_ids: All exact conflicting comment revision identities to resolve; omitting a conflict is rejected.
reason: Reason recorded for this state transition or moderation action.
moderation_reason: Reason retained with the authorized moderation action.
expected_thread_version: Exact observed review-thread version for this workflow transition.
id: Exact project, task or comment identity selected by the command; creation may supply a stable explicit identity.
body: Complete intended Markdown body. Edits replace the body rather than applying a text patch.
project: Project identity in the current metadata home repository.
repository: Stable linked code repository identity. A metadata link does not grant access to that repository.
expected_project_version: Exact observed project version; protects task placement and project relationships.
parent: Parent task identity. Omission on a complete task edit clears the parent relationship.
state: Complete intended task state. These values describe work tracking, not code or agent execution state.
task: Task identity in the current metadata home repository.
expected_task_version: Exact observed task version guarding the comment or relationship change.
reply_to: Exact existing task comment identity being replied to; omission creates a top-level comment.
attempt: Exact durable native Git publication attempt identity to inspect or recover.
endpoint: Explicit server endpoint. Credentials must never appear in the URL; TLS and loopback policy still apply.
repo_id: Full repository identity at the selected server endpoint.
principal: Stable principal identity receiving the authorization grant.
permission: Repository permission to grant; administration requires the applicable authority.
expires_at: Optional token expiry timestamp as Unix seconds. Omission leaves expiry unspecified.
token_stdin: Read the required credential from standard input rather than putting a secret in command arguments.
request: Private path to the durable secret-free request journal. Status and retry reuse this exact journal.
token_id: Public credential identity to revoke; this is not the bearer secret.
destination: Destination directory for the physical workspace. Initial attachment checks its existing contents before writing.
insecure_loopback: Explicitly permit the supported plain-HTTP literal-loopback connection; does not disable admission for other hosts.
ca_certificate: Path to the CA certificate used to verify the configured TLS endpoint.
workspace: Native workspace name recorded for the attachment.
cache: Path for disposable client cache data; cache content is not repository authority.
state_dir: Private installation or local service state directory. Production control state must remain outside checkouts.
server_config: Path to the local service's strict format-2 TOML configuration.
command: Command topic whose application help should be displayed.
keyword: Named application guide topic to display.
timeout: Maximum wait duration for the captured sync frontier, in the duration syntax accepted by this parser.
no_pager: Write output directly instead of invoking the configured pager.
color: Control terminal color rendering independently of the output data format.
local: Initialize the supported private LocalTrusted installation and managed embedded storage configuration.
rustfs_executable: Explicit path to the paired embedded RustFS runtime executable.
config: Path to the strict server TOML configuration for this operation.
name: Human-readable repository discovery name; the stable repository identity remains authoritative.
policy: Private operator or repository authorization policy file used by the offline administration command.
shell: Shell for which to emit completion definitions. Emission does not install them.
